title: Agentic Distributional Regression: Conditional Density Estimation through Agent-Written Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.37611v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper we propose a method for estimating conditional densities from an iid sample using a language-model agent. The agent writes the estimator as a short program that, for each covariate value, returns the estimated conditional distribution of the response. The program is built from a library of probability distributions, so the returned law can be a parametric distribution, a mixture or a multivariate factorization, with parameters given by explicit functions of the covariates. Since the number of operations and constants in the program is limited, the fitted conditional density is a formula that can be inspected and evaluated independently of the agent, while the choice of the model structure and of the fitting procedure is left to the agent. We call this approach agentic distributional regression (ADR). Treating the returned program as a random conditional density estimator, we derive a finite-sample error bound under explic

translated_title: 智能体分布式回归：通过智能体编写的程序进行条件密度估计
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种利用语言模型智能体从独立同分布样本中估计条件密度的方法。该智能体将估计器编写为一个简短的程序，对于每个协变量取值，该程序返回响应变量的估计条件分布。程序由概率分布库构建而成，因此返回的分布可以是参数分布、混合分布或多变量分解，其参数由协变量的显式函数给出。由于程序中的运算和常数的数量有限，拟合的条件密度是一个可以独立于智能体进行检验和求值的公式，而模型结构和拟合程序的选择则留给智能体完成。我们将这种方法称为智能体分布式回归。将返回的程序视为一个随机的条件密度估计器，我们在显式假设条件下推导出了有限样本误差界……
tldr: 提出智能体分布式回归（ADR）方法，让语言模型智能体编写基于概率分布库的简短程序来估计条件密度，得到的可检验公式不仅透明可评估，还具备有限样本误差界保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes Agentic Distributional Regression (ADR), where a language-model agent writes short programs from a probability distribution library to estimate conditional densities, yielding inspectable, independently evaluable formulas with finite-sample error bound guarantees.
